goals: Extend CNM ShapeMap families with BGE-owned geometry while preserving Nibaru-owned material identity and semantics.
Provide six-direction Layer geometry for every canonical family with CNM's one-source combined-placement economy, without changing accepted Step or Vertical behavior.
scope: Maintain BGE-owned placement, state, rendering, collision, drops, and specialized behavior for generated geometry.

Generate exactly one Layer after Step for each of 311 canonical ShapeMap families, preserving deterministic 933/933 Vertical, Step, and Layer population and guarding generated Layers from recursive Nibaru material discovery.

Preserve six-direction facing, one-through-four 4-pixel thickness, waterlogging, free same-item exposed-face growth after the first funded placement, one-full-source break return, material pattern and axis behavior, typed DROP_BASE transitions, profile-driven specialized semantics, and a shared centered Layer item projection.

exclusions: Nibaru owns canonical material identity, visual roles, capabilities, transitions, copied settings, and material, pattern, and axis semantics.
CNM ShapeMap remains the canonical material-family and switching mechanism; BGE must not create a competing material registry or selector.
Corner geometry is frozen out of scope.
Quarter Column geometry is frozen out of scope.
BBB is reference-only; its source and assets are excluded, and BGE has no BBB dependency.
Accepted Step and Vertical behavior and Glazed production behavior remain unchanged except for migration-only path normalization.

dependencies.reason: BGE C54 consumes Nibaru C46 canonical-parent Layer and typed DROP_BASE contracts.

Provides the canonical ShapeMap family and geometry-switching mechanism extended by BGE.
Provides the exact Nibaru C46 material-profile and Layer contract implementation paired with C54.

state.milestone: Exact BGE C54 and its required exact Nibaru C46 contract artifact are deployed together in Slot A with manager revision 37 readiness verified and runtime UNTESTED. C54 repairs predecessor C53's demonstrated same-block Layer consumption failure and off-center item presentation while preserving the reported correct one-full-source return, falling-material behavior, grass lifecycle, and glass/translucency. Accepted BGE C52 and Nibaru C45 remain disabled as the unchanged rollback baseline under the slot-scoped dependency override.
